title: Daily high temperature and iced drinks sold by a food truck
bodyMd: The owner of a food truck recorded the daily high temperature and the number of iced drinks sold on six days in one week. The table below shows the results.

data.caption: Daily high temperature and number of iced drinks sold by one food truck on six days.

accessibilityText: A six-row table with three columns: day, daily high temperature x in degrees Fahrenheit, and number of iced drinks sold y. Monday: 64 degrees, 101 drinks. Tuesday: 72 degrees, 121 drinks. Wednesday: 80 degrees, 175 drinks. Thursday: 68 degrees, 125 drinks. Friday: 58 degrees, 92 drinks. Saturday: 84 degrees, 160 drinks.

provenance.notes: Original data set written for this item bank. The values were chosen so that the residuals from the model in the question are whole numbers with distinct sizes and a mix of signs.
